 Allan Jean-Baptiste and Marco DeMeireles – Under-covered Venture Markets and Teams at Ansa Capital (Manager Meetings, EP.36) Sep 1, 2022

 On today’s Manager Meeting, Andy
Golden interviews Allan Jean-Baptiste and Marco DeMeireles of Ansa
Capital. Andy is President of PRINCO where he has overseen the
management of Princeton University’s endowment since 1995.
Alongside his long successful tenure, he is a master with wordplay
and the use of the pun.

Allan and Marco are the Co-Founders and General Partners of Ansa
Capital, a thesis-driven growth equity fund launched earlier this
year with backing from an impressive list of LPs.

Their conversation covers Ansa’s long-term perspective, approach to
partnerships, risk management, team dynamics, and operating model.
Allan and Marco also share their perspective on current market
conditions, the opportunity set, and raising their first
fund.

 About the Podcast 
 
 
 Allocator and asset management expert, Ted Seides, conducts in-depth interviews with leaders in the institutional investing industry. Guests include Chief Investment Officers from leading allocators, asset managers, strategists, thought leaders, and many more. Our mission is to learn, share, and help implement the process of premier investors. Learn more and join our community at capitalallocators.com.
